name: pCloud sign-in
description: Signs a pCloud account in through pCloud's own authorization endpoint.

codes.pcloud_oauth.bad_reply: pCloud sent a reply this plugin could not read.
codes.pcloud_oauth.client_not_configured: This account has no registered pCloud application. Enter the app key and app secret first.
codes.pcloud_oauth.code_expired: The sign-in expired or was already used before it was finished. Start it again.
codes.pcloud_oauth.consent_denied: The sign-in was not granted at pCloud.
codes.pcloud_oauth.flow_unsupported: pCloud is signed in through the browser, not with a device code.
codes.pcloud_oauth.no_entropy: The sign-in could not be started because the application had no randomness for it. Try again.
codes.pcloud_oauth.renewal_unsupported: pCloud issues nothing to renew a sign-in with. If it stops working, sign in again.
